actions.action: Make presets transparent, optional starting points.
actions.mechanism: Show each preset’s changes before applying; preserve custom combinations unless the owner explicitly chooses replacement.
actions.implementation: Replace the undocumented preset with a permission list and an Apply button. Leave publishing and billing unselected, requiring separate owner selection.
actions.check: Load a custom combination, change an unrelated invite field, and confirm every permission remains unchanged. Applying a preset must not grant privileged access.
actions.risk: Preset descriptions can drift; derive their lists from configured permissions.

actions.action: Preview what the teammate can actually do.
actions.mechanism: Calculate effective permissions before saving, exposing inherited or dependent access rather than merely repeating toggle states.
actions.implementation: Show draft viewing, reviewing, publishing, and billing outcomes with their permission sources. Block sending if effective publishing or billing lacks explicit owner selection.
actions.check: Configure an indirect publishing grant without owner selection. The preview must report publishing access, and sending must remain blocked.
actions.risk: Stale previews mislead; recalculate after changes and immediately before sending.

actions.action: Test the invite against the intended job.
actions.mechanism: Turn “review drafts but not publish” into explicit expectations checked against calculated effective permissions.
actions.implementation: Offer keyboard-selectable expectations: draft review allowed and publishing denied. Run these assertions before sending; surface mismatches without automatically changing permissions.
actions.check: Start with passing expectations, then enable publishing. The pre-send test must fail and prevent sending until permissions or expectations are explicitly revised.
actions.risk: Expectations cover selected tasks only; label them as targeted checks.

actions.action: Organize all toggles without hiding custom settings.
actions.mechanism: Group the 18 controls by task while keeping every existing combination accessible and visibly marked as custom when appropriate.
actions.implementation: Use native checkboxes in labeled fieldsets, an Expand all button, and group summaries showing selected permissions. Preserve values when groups collapse.
actions.check: Using only Tab, Shift+Tab, Space, and Enter, configure review without publishing. Expand every group and verify all 18 controls remain reachable.
actions.risk: Collapsed groups can obscure access; keep publishing and billing summaries visible.
